Bought this backpack for a two-week trip through Portugal and it held up great. I was worried about the zippers because the reviews were kind of mixed, but mine worked fine the whole time. No snags, no sticking.

It fit way more than I expected. I crammed in five days of clothes, a rain jacket, my camera, and still had room for snacks. The side pockets are a little tight for a water bottle though. I had to really shove it in there, which got annoying at train stations when I was in a hurry.

The straps dug into my shoulders a bit on the longer walking days. Not terrible, but I noticed it by the afternoon. If you're going to carry it fully loaded for hours, maybe size up or pad the straps.

One thing I really liked: the laptop sleeve actually fits a 15-inch laptop without a fight. My old bag claimed it did and then squeezed the thing half to death.

Would I buy it again? Yeah, probably. It's not fancy and the color faded a touch in the sun, but it did the job and didn't fall apart. For the price I paid, I can't really complain. My brother saw it and ordered the same one, so take that as you will.
